{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Real agricultural producer price indices and per-capita output value by World Bank income tier and commodity group, 2005–2023

The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Statistics Division compiled country-level agricultural producer prices deflated by consumer price indices alongside gross per-capita agricultural output from 2005 to 2023. The dataset evaluates terms of trade shocks, commodity-specific volatility, and structural agricultural output differences across global income classifications.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `commodity_group` | category | Cereal Grains, Oilcrops & Pulses, Livestock & Dairy, Horticulture & Fruits; group production |
| `income_group` | category | Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income; ordered=ordinal; group socioeconomic |
| `market_orientation` | category | Domestic Staple, Export Cash Crop; group market |
| `per_capita_output_value` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `real_producer_price_index` | measure | unit index; non-additive |
| `record_period` | time | 2005-01-01 to 2023-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `region` | category | Sub-Saharan Africa, East Africa & Sahel, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Latin America & Caribbean, East Asia & Pacific, North America, Western Europe; within income_group; group socioeconomic |
| `yoy_real_price_change` | measure | unit %; non-additive |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by income_group, AVG(per_capita_output_value), unit USD
    p0 reads income_group off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Compare average per-capita agricultural output value across different country income groups
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by record_period, AVG(real_producer_price_index), unit index
    p0 reads record_period off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Track the trajectory and shocks in the real agricultural producer price index over time
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(real_producer_price_index, yoy_real_price_change), unit %, index
    drawn to answer: Evaluate whether higher deflated producer price indices are correlated with annual real price percentage changes
- `f04`
    p0: pie, grouped by commodity_group, SUM(per_capita_output_value), unit USD
    p0 reads commodity_group off the inline label
